jobs.title: Project Director - Solar Works
jobs.organization: Private Power & Infrastructure Board (PPIB)
jobs.description:
Role purpose
Head the PPIB Project Management Unit for Solar Works (PMU-Solar) and be accountable for planning, coordination and timely delivery of the solar components of the 100 MWp GB project within the sanctioned scope, budget and implementation arrangements.
Key responsibilities
Lead the PMU-Solar, establish the integrated execution programme, monitor milestones, expenditure, quality, risks and corrective actions for rooftop and utility-scale PV, associated BESS and plant-level C&C/SCADA.
Oversee formal takeover of solar-project records, ongoing procurements and contractual obligations from W&PD GB, including Rooftop Lots I & II, Lot III and applicable consultancy contracts, through duly approved arrangements.
Coordinate procurement and contract administration for the remaining solar packages, including the utility-scale plants, in collaboration with the relevant PPIB sections and the appointed consultants.
Direct and coordinate the inputs of EPC contractors, NESPAK and the independent TPV consultant; ensure that review findings, non-conformities, milestone verification and payment-related conditions are resolved and recorded.
Maintain an integrated interface schedule with W&PD GB/PMU Non-Solar for site access, grid interconnections, transmission/distribution facilities and project-wide C&C/SCADA without assuming execution of those non-solar packages.
Oversee project financial planning, PSDP reporting and approved payment processing, contract risks, stakeholder coordination, O&M transition and final handover, through competent/authorized officers.
Prepare or coordinate reporting to PPIB, Power Division, the Steering Committee and Planning Commission, including progress, PC-III/RBM information, completion/PC-IV inputs and audit responses.
Prepare annual cash and work plans before commencement of each financial year and oversee the operation and management of project accounts in accordance with applicable financial rules and approved arrangements.
Regularly update project progress in the prescribed Planning Commission reporting systems, including PMES/iPAS, as applicable, and prepare quarterly and annual progress reports.
Establish performance indicators for PMU-Solar personnel and periodically evaluate their performance.
Ensure proper maintenance and custody of all project documents, accounts, assets, contractual records and audit reports.
Exercise delegated administrative, functional and financial powers in accordance with applicable rules and remain

The Manager - Strategy and Partnerships will support PSEB's international market development, strategic partnerships and export promotion agenda to increase Pakistan's IT & IT-Enabled Services (ITeS) exports. The position will focus on identifying international buyers and partners, preparing and executing country-specific market plans, developing qualified commercial opportunities and tracking outcomes throughout the year. The Manager will work with Pakistani IT companies, foreign missions, Trade & Investment Counsellors (TICs), diaspora networks, industry associations, development partners and international organizations. Candidates from other academic disciplines with relevant professional experience directly related to the experience requirements and responsibilities of this role are also encouraged to apply.

Demonstrated ability in relationship development, market analysis, negotiation, stakeholder management and commercial opportunity development is required.
Experience in IT & ITeS, export promotion, international client engagement or B2B/G2B/G2G engagements will be considered an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.

Provide strategic oversight of all functional directorates: HR, Operations, Legal, Audit & Inspection, Product Development & Management and any other CDNS directorates.
Propose creation and restructuring of organizational units to improve efficiency and service delivery.
Define, assign, and periodically review job descriptions for all posts of CDNS.

Lead the preparation and submission of proposals for the administrative budget to Finance Division through the CF&AO.

Drive a culture of meritocracy, accountability, and continuous professional development across CDNS.
Initiate talent development programs and succession planning for leadership roles.
Digital Transformation & Technology
Lead CDNS's digital transformation agenda, including the development and rollout of online savings platforms and mobile banking interfaces.

jobs.title: TEAM LEADER / DEPUTY COORDINATOR / EXECUTIVE SECRETARY (MP-I)
jobs.organization: Prime Minister Office (Public) Islamabad
jobs.description:
Required Educational Qualification and Experience:
Ph.D in International Trade, Economics, Public Policy, Law, Business Administration or another relevant subject, with at least seven (07) years' professional experience in the relevant field; OR a Master’s degree in any of these relevant subjects, with at least nine (09) years' experience in the relevant field.
Professional training in trade facilitation, customs, WTO agreements or supply chain management is desirable.
Experience:
Relevant post qualification experience (trade policy, customs, trade facilitation or related public sector/private-sector work) shall be at least seven (07) years for candidates holding a relevant Ph.D or nine (09) years for candidates holding a relevant Master's degree. Demonstrated progressive experience in trade policy, customs, trade facilitation, cross-border trade or related public/private sector work, including more than five (05) years’ experience in senior management or team leadership, is desirable.
Core Competencies:
Strategic leadership; negotiation and consensus-building; analytical and report-writing ability; project and results-based management; digital literacy; excellent written and spoken communication; integrity and impartiality.
Age:
Maximum 62 Years as on the closing date of submission of application.
Period of Contract:
Initially for a period of three (03) years, extendable for another term of two (02) years (on yearly basis) upon satisfactory performance of each year and/or as per MP Policy as amended from time to time.
Other Details:
As per MP Scales Policy, 2020 Shortlisting criteria and ToRs of the vacancies, including relevant qualifications, relevant experience, job specifications, job descriptions, deliverables and timelines can be accessed /downloaded from the official website of Prime Minister’s Office www.pmo.gov.pk/career

jobs.title: SENIOR ASSOCIATE / LEGAL ADVISER AND PUBLIC PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP (PPP) MANAGER (MP-II)
jobs.organization: Prime Minister Office (Public) Islamabad
jobs.description:

Ph.D in Law with at least five (05) years' professional experience in the relevant field; OR a Master's degree in Law (LLM) with at least seven (07) years' professional experience in the relevant field.
Enrolment as an advocate is desirable.
Professional training in trade facilitation, customs, WTO agreements, PPP, contract negotiation or supply chain management is desirable.

Experience shall include three (03) years in managing or advising on public-private partnerships or public-private dialogue in cross-border trade facilitation and/or supply chain management is desirable.

Strong legal drafting and analytical ability; negotiation and consensus-building; partnership and stakeholder management; strategic thinking and sound judgment; project and results-based management; digital literacy; excellent written and spoken communication; integrity, confidentiality and impartiality.
